footer: You receive this email because you have a HoPetSit account.

welcome_provider_d1.subject: {{name}}, 3 things that bring your first requests
welcome_provider_d1.title: Welcome to HoPetSit, {{name}}!
paragraphs: Your profile is live. Three things make the difference for owners: a photo of you (not your pet), a 3-line introduction and your rates.
Complete, verified profiles (✓ badge) get the vast majority of requests. It takes 5 minutes in the app.
Then open the PawMap: owners around you see you right on the map.

welcome_owner_d1.subject: {{name}}, your first care request is free
welcome_owner_d1.title: Welcome to HoPetSit, {{name}}!
paragraphs: You can post a request right now (sitting, visit or walk): sitters and walkers near you see it and reply by chat.
Payment is held in the app until the service is done, and you can follow the walk live with PawFollow.
Have a look at the PawMap too: pet-friendly places, members around you, directions.

profile_incomplete_d3.subject: {{name}}, owners can't see your profile yet
profile_incomplete_d3.title: One detail is missing on your profile
paragraphs: An owner never books a profile without a photo, an introduction or a rate. Yours is missing at least one.
Add them now: a photo of you, 3 lines about your experience with animals, and a starting rate. You can adjust it anytime.

first_client_d7.subject: {{name}}, your first client is already in your phone
first_client_d7.title: Your first client, this week
paragraphs: A pet sitter's first clients almost always come from people they know: neighbours, colleagues, friends with a dog or a cat.
Send them your HoPetSit profile link on WhatsApp or Instagram. For them: secure payment and live tracking. For you: a first review, and your profile moves up for everyone.
Offer a first booking at a gentle rate: the review is what matters.

owner_first_request_d5.subject: {{name}}, who looks after your pet next time?
owner_first_request_d5.title: Plan the next absence
paragraphs: Weekend, holidays, a long workday: post your request a few days ahead, sitters reply faster when they have time to organise.
Posting is free. Compare verified profiles, chat, and book only if it suits you.

inactive_d21.subject: {{name}}, what's new on HoPetSit
inactive_d21.title: What changed since your last visit
paragraphs: The PawMap now offers directions on foot, by bike or by car, opening hours of pet-friendly places, and free live location sharing between friends.
Verified sitters and walkers appear on the map around you. Come back for a look, the app has moved on a lot.

review_after_booking.subject: {{name}}, how did the booking go?
review_after_booking.title: Thank you for using HoPetSit
paragraphs: If everything went well, two small things help us enormously: a review on the person's profile, and a rating on the App Store or Google Play. A young app lives on its reviews.
Know someone who would like HoPetSit? Your referral code is in your profile: you both earn PawPoints.
